# IHRU 1.º Direito programme execution, 2020

IHRU's [1.º Direito — Relatório de Execução, October
2020](https://portaldahabitacao.pt/documents/20126/58203/Relat%C3%B3rio%20Execu%C3%A7%C3%A3o%201.%C2%BA%20Direito/5820bc32-4ac4-63c3-f142-22b2630aab09)
contains programme implementation observations and planned financing values.

- Downstream PDF: `ihru_1d_execucao_2020.pdf`, 2,785,442 bytes.
- SHA-256 in `data/sources/housing_cost_sources.json`:
  `fda77dc96a81c08388947bce5947624be279fd31bb140ddcd93ddb6f241d4766`.
- Research retrieval date: 30 October 2026.
- Cited location: PDF page 34, including the historical average of
  **€794.19/m²** for construction financing contracts.

Planned investments per dwelling, including the IHRU programme's modality
breakdowns, are not equivalent to audited construction costs or total project
costs including land, fees, VAT and financing. These observations predate the
2026 housing market and must not be used as a 2026 €/m² calibration without
adjustments and scope reconciliation.

**Metadata-only external source.** The research project's source manifest
records the exact PDF identity, but no PDF or derived figures are copied
into the registry pending a redistribution-rights determination.
